item.title: 15x Major Winner Tiger Woods turns 50
item.description: 15x time Major Winner Tiger Woods turns 50 today. Woods has played sparingly since suffering career-threatening injuries in a car crash in 2021. He was last in competitive golf action at the Open Championship in July 2024. Advertisement

item.title: Over 820 motorists in Kerry penalisied for driving while using a mobile phone in 2025
item.description: Over 820 drivers in Kerry have been penalised for using a mobile phone while driving this year. That’s according to figures released to Radio Kerry by the Regional Chief Superintendent for the Southern Garda Region, Colm O’Sullivan. The data shows more than 300 motorists in the county have been fined for not wearing a seat belt while driving. item.title: Fewer than 250 homes commenced in Kerry in first 11 months of 2025
item.description: Fewer than 250 new homes have been commenced in Kerry this year. Data from the Department of Housing shows that construction has begun on fewer homes this year in Kerry than any year since 2016. 239 new homes have been commenced in Kerry up to the end of November this year. Advertisement 163 of these are one-off houses, 25 are apartments, and 51 are part of larger housing schemes. item.title: City closing in on signing of Semenyo from Bournemouth
item.description: Manchester City are close to reaching a full agreement with Bournemouth for the signing of Antoine Semenyo. It's understood talks are now at an advanced stage, ahead of the Ghana winger's 65-million-pound release clause becoming active on New Year's Day - when the transfer window opens. Personal terms are also believed to be close to being finalised. Advertisement Semenyo is in the Bournemouth squad for tonight's Premier League game at Chelsea.

item.title: Meals on Wheels Tralee and Killarney expects to serve 23,000 meals in 2025 as demand surges
item.description: There has been a sharp surge in demand for meals on wheels services in Kerry this year. The director of Meals on Wheels Tralee and Killarney, Paddy Kevane, says thousands of more meals have been delivered in 2025, compared to last year. The charity served 17,500 meals last year, but expects to give out up to 23,000 meals by the end of this year. item.title: Castleisland to celebrate 800 years since town’s foundation next year
item.description: The history of Castleisland will be celebrated next year (2026) to mark 800 years since the foundation of the town. An event will take place in early May and will celebrate the construction of the Castle and the foundation of the town back in 1226. item.title: Former Cork City manager Ger Nash has joined Swedish side Mjallby
item.description: Former Cork City manager Ger Nash has joined Swedish side Mjallby as an assistant coach. He announced his departure from Turner's Cross last week, with the Leesiders preparing for the First Division following relegation last season. Mjallby are gearing up to defend their title in the upcoming Swedish top-flight season, having won the league for the first time in 2025. Advertisement

item.title: Augustus set for a spell on the sidelines for Ulster
item.description: Ulster have confirmed that back-rower Juarno Augustus will be out for a number of weeks with an ankle ligament injury. The South African picked up the issue midway through their 29-24 victory away to Connacht in the URC last weekend. It rules him out of Friday's visit of Munster to Belfast - Iain Henderson Rob Herring are also doubts for that game. Advertisement
